title: Bombard
name: Folvilles
description: The Bombard is a brigand who changed sides yet still proudly wears the clothes he raided the Hamlet in. He is loud in conversation and combat, and louder still when drunk, which is often. He expects, sooner or later, that his pardon will be withdrawn and someone will come for him, and he keeps one charge in reserve for that day.
history: The Bombard was a miner before he was a criminal, and brought the trade's explosives with him when he took up with the brigands. He served Vvulf as his demolition man until the Estate began hiring killers and brigands started dying in numbers. He did the arithmetic and defected in the night. Plainly useful, and more dangerous left out there, he was taken on for wages and amnesty.
summary: A volatile and mercenary Bombard, a defected brigand demolitionist working the Estate for wages and amnesty.

appearance.hairStyle: Long and unkempt (hidden by his helm)
appearance.features: Gap-toothed, with powder burns speckled across one cheek

clothing.head: Riveted steel helm enclosing the whole head, with three vertical slits
clothing.body: Patched olive-green brigand coat with steel plates strapped over it
clothing.accessories: A steel belly plate bearing the brigands' red skull, a leather harness of fused bombs, thick gauntlets

notes: Speaks in demolition and structural jargon, interspersed with frequent obscene swearing and cheap common-stock proverbs
Snorts gunpowder as a stimulant, and drinks heavily and continuously
Unwelcome among the Hamlet's townsfolk, and disliked at the Guild most of all
While loud and fun to be around, he does not trust easily, and regards his teammates as co-workers, not comrades
